templates.name: Small Deployment
templates.description: Single-site design with compact DMZ, dual internet uplinks, centralized logging, and a modest privileged access boundary for smaller operations teams.

templates.name: Medium Deployment
templates.description: Multi-segment architecture with dedicated management network, separate backup zone, SIEM platform, and redundant application tiers.

templates.name: Large Enterprise
templates.description: Enterprise-scale reference with regional ingress points, layered DMZ, east-west segmentation, privileged session recording, and centralized governance.

templates.name: Air-Gapped OT
templates.description: Highly restricted design using one-way transfer controls, bastion workflows, offline patch staging, and strict media handling between IT and OT.

templates.name: High Availability
templates.description: Redundant security and compute pattern using clustered firewalls, active-active load balancers, replicated storage, and HA monitoring paths.

templates.name: Disaster Recovery
templates.description: Resilient design with failover connectivity, replicated backups, warm standby security controls, and predefined recovery sequences.

templates.name: Multi-Cloud
templates.description: Cloud-spanning landing zone with shared identity, cloud-native controls, central SIEM, and standardized network security policies.

templates.name: Hybrid Cloud
templates.description: Hybrid reference joining on-prem data centre workloads with public cloud services through private connectivity, shared IAM, and consistent monitoring.
